description: A shell script used for flashing bootloader images on a device named 'stingray'. It contains functions to verify device type, locate bootloader files, and execute flashing commands, along with placeholders for flashing userdata and radio images.

methods.name: flash_bootloader_image
methods.description: Flashes the bootloader image onto the device if the device type is 'stingray'. It verifies the bootloader file path and existence before flashing.

methods.name: flash_userdata_image
methods.description: Placeholder for flashing userdata image; currently not supported, just logs a skip message.

methods.name: flash_radio_image
methods.description: Placeholder for flashing radio image; currently not supported, just logs a skip message.
